pairs.note: Answer is only the bare figure "10%" without stating what it refers to (random sample of subsequent expert calls chaperoned by Compliance). It omits nearly all required elements of the key: chaperoning of the first call with each new expert, use of only CCO-approved networks, scheduling/pre-approval of each consultation through the network platform, exclusion of current public-company/government employees and persons with a confidentiality duty, the MNPI reminder at the start of each call, and retention of analyst call notes.
